system.description:
A weapon or suit of armor you touch sprouts dense thorns.

Weapons become magical and deal +[[/r 1d4]] damage for the spell’s duration.

Armor becomes magical and deals [[/r 1d4]] damage to anyone who hits its wearer with a melee attack for the spell’s duration.

If your deity is @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.patrons-and-deities.Item.FhDBOHUircue27aV]{Gede}, cast this spell with ADV.
